title: Convergence of the summed multiplier error
statement: Let $\iota$ be any type, and let $d_i\in\mathbb N$ and $c_i\in\mathbb R$ be indexed by $i\in\iota$. If $\sum_{i\in\iota}(d_ic_i)^2$ is finite, then as $t$ tends to $0$ through positive values, $\sum_{i\in\iota}\bigl((m_{d_i}(t)-d_i)c_i\bigr)^2$ tends to $0$.
